bio.zh: 你在帆缆之间长大,双手比言语更可靠。
bio.en: You grew up between mast and deck; your hands speak louder than words.

bio.zh: 你在皇家舰队的桅楼上见过第一缕晨光,号令与星图是童年的母语。
bio.en: You saw your first dawn from a royal masthead; the pipe of orders and the star chart were your childhood tongue.

bio.zh: 在商行的账房里,你学会了看秤算息,也知道哪句话能压下三个铜板。
bio.en: In a counting house you learned the scales and the interest tables — and which sentence knocks three coppers off a price.

bio.zh: 在制图师的阁楼里,你把一条条海岸线描进了梦里。
bio.en: In the chartmaker's garret you inked coastline after coastline into your dreams.

bio.zh: 码头酒馆里跑腿千次,你早知道每句醉话都可能是一条值钱的线报。
bio.en: A thousand errands through the harbor taverns taught you that every drunkard's tale may be a rumour worth coin.

bio.zh: 剑馆里练废了十柄木剑,腕上的旧茧比任何文凭都硬。
bio.en: You wore out ten training blades in the fencing hall; the callus on your wrist is diploma enough.
